title: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup
description: Velvety squash soup made with oven-roasted butternut, onion and a hint of warm spice, blended smooth with vegetable broth.

image.alt: A bowl of smooth orange squash soup with a cream swirl and toasted seeds

ingredients.prep: peeled, seeded and cut into {len 1 in} chunks

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. Toss the squash, onion and garlic with the oil and 1 tsp of the salt on the baking sheet and spread them out in one layer.
Roast, stirring halfway, until the squash is soft and browned at the edges, {time 35-40 min}.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins into the pot and add the roasted squash, onion, broth, cinnamon and nutmeg. Bring to a simmer and cook for {time 10 min}.
Blend until completely smooth, keeping an immersion blender’s blade under the surface, or in batches in a blender with the lid vented and covered with a towel.
Thin with more broth if you like, then season with the rest of the salt and the maple syrup to taste.

notes: A swirl of coconut milk or a spoon of yogurt and some toasted pumpkin seeds make good toppings.
Freezes well for up to 3 months.
